hook: Your room lights are flickering right now.
title: Your Room Lights Are Flickering Right Now
description:
Many bulbs pulse with the mains power, and India's supply runs at 50 hertz. Your eyes blur it into steady light, but a phone in slow motion catches the dark bands rolling across the screen. Results vary by bulb and phone. Part of the Try This Now series.

#Shorts #TryThisNow #PhoneTricks
